title: Students Identifying as Cats
summary: False claims that schools are providing litter boxes or special accommodations for students who identify as cats or 'furries'.
introduction: Since late 2021, a persistent hoax has circulated claiming that schools are installing litter boxes in bathrooms or making other accommodations for students who identify as cats or animals. This misinformation has been repeatedly promoted by politicians and media personalities despite being thoroughly debunked by school officials, fact-checkers, and researchers worldwide. Every school district named in these claims has confirmed they are false. The hoax is often used as anti-transgender rhetoric and to undermine LGBTQ+ student protections.
